text.en:
Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, non-Filipino citizens serving on the staff
of American Kor-Asian Foundation, Inc., an association organized exclusively for charitable purposes, shall
be exempted from the payment of income taxes on their salaries and stipends in dollars received by them by
reason of services rendered to the American Kor-Asian Foundation, Inc.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
